systems.platform: Service Oriented Architecture, publish and subscribe model
systems.owner: Ministry of Technology, Communication and Innovation; hosted at the Government Online Centre; project management by the Central Informatics Bureau
systems.tiers: Ministries, departments and parastatal bodies (e.g. CBRD, CSD, EDB, MRA, NTA)

note: InfoHighway is an exchange platform with no interoperability framework named behind it (it cites a Data Sharing Policy and a list of Acts, not a framework); no fact.
